guardrails: none: no citation gate, no critic, fix not forced to need approval
rationale: emailservice shows the largest anomalies in the digest: memory up 39.2% (z=+7.85) while its latency-50 dropped 69% (z=-13.84) and CPU fell 34%, consistent with a memory fault, or a degraded service that returns fast failures. checkoutservice logs 136 'failed to send order confirmation ... Unimplemented: Method not found' errors (a call to emailservice), but that error is an API/method mismatch rather than a resource fault, so the fault type is a weak inference.

proposed_fix.description: Inspect emailservice for memory growth and verify its deployed version and gRPC SendOrderConfirmation method match what checkoutservice calls; if memory is leaking or a wrong build is running, restart or roll back emailservice to the last known-good version.
